Interface SimulationStatisticCollector

public interface SimulationStatisticCollector
Abstraction for statistics collection during simulation. Implemented by UI monitors (console/chart) and server-side sinks. PetriObjModel depends only on this interface — no DTO imports needed.

    • onFiringPhase

      default void onFiringPhase(double time, FiringPhase phase, PetriT transition, Iterable<PetriSim> objects)
      Called once per atomic firing phase, on the simulation thread, in the order the phases occur — between the onTimeStep(double, ua.stetsenkoinna.petriobj.PetriNet, int) calls of two time steps rather than instead of them. Collectors that only report statistics ignore it; a streaming one turns the phases into the animation steps a client replays between two snapshots.

      Default-implemented on purpose: a firing phase is finer-grained than anything this interface promised before, and a collector that has no use for one should not have to say so.

      Parameters:
      time - model current time at the instant the phase was recorded
      phase - which instant of the firing this is
      transition - the transition being fired
      objects - the whole model's object list — read markings and buffers synchronously, the arrays are mutated by the next firing
